data.title: A competition for a map of Great Moravia
data.excerpt: Together with the Slovia company we have prepared a competition in which you can both help to improve our site and win a valuable prize. Send us photographs of the hillforts described on hradiska.sk for which we still have no pictures, and the author of the best photographs, chosen by a readers' vote, will win a finely made map of Great Moravia.
data.metaTitle: A competition for a map of Great Moravia
data.metaDescription: A photo competition run with the Slovia company: send us pictures of hillforts and win a finely made map of Great Moravia or of Samo's Empire.

mediaTexts.alt: An educational map of Great Moravia with borders, settlements and drawings of figures and finds

Anyone can enter the competition. All you have to do is
send us photographs of one of the hillforts
that are described on our site
for which we do not yet have photographs.
There are still quite a lot of them; off the top of my head I can mention Skalka nad Váhom, Krivín, Kusín, Tomášovce, Mužla and many other hillforts.

Your photographs will then be published on our site and in the Facebook discussion. On the basis of a readers' vote we will then choose the author of the best photographs, who will receive the map of Great Moravia mentioned above.
You can send the photographs to
and they will then be published on this site and on Facebook.
The prize for the competition was provided by the Slovia company.
